values./system/biography: A tougher feral ghoul that stalks the dark attractions of Nuka-World.
values./items/@fe2076dad82a32e6/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@2459be9f16c62ead/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@4f2b49fa96d8ef57/system/descript: It cannot be influenced by Speech and attacks the nearest enemy.
values./items/@baafa4c39e11af74/system/descript: It regains 1 HP per 3 Radiation damage prevented.
values./items/@b6fde6e62fe2244e/system/descript: When prone, only a difficulty 2 PER + Survival test distinguishes it from a corpse.
